title: loop-library: open catalog of field-tested agent loops at loopany.ai
summary: Jason Zhou introduces loop-library, an open-source catalog at loopany.ai/templates of named agent loops claimed to have shipped in production, each with a copy-paste prompt for Cursor, Claude, or Codex.
